{{recipesummary|category=Appetizer recipes|servings=12|time=30 minutes|difficulty=2}}{{recipe}}

'''Angels on horseback''' are oysters wrapped in bacon strips and broiled.

==Ingredients==
* ½ cup dry white [[Cookbook:Wine|wine]]
* 1 clove [[Cookbook:Garlic|garlic]], [[Cookbook:Mincing|minced]]
* [[Cookbook:Salt|Salt]] to taste
* [[Cookbook:Pepper|Pepper]] to taste
* 12 shucked [[Cookbook:Oyster|oysters]]
* 6 slices lean [[Cookbook:Bacon|bacon]]

==Procedure==
#Mix the wine, garlic, salt, and pepper together. Add the oysters and marinate 10 to 20 minutes.
#Preheat the [[Cookbook:Broiler|broiler]]. 
#Cut each bacon slice in half and wrap each oyster with a piece of bacon, securing with a [[Cookbook:Toothpick|toothpick]].
#Broil on both sides until the bacon is crisp. You may also cook them on an outdoor or rangetop [[Cookbook:Grill|grill]].
